mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide increases photosensitivity risk, and tazarotene (a retinoid) also causes photosensitivity and skin irritation, with additive effects on dermatological toxicity and UV sensitivity.
action: Counsel patients on strict sun protection (SPF 30+, protective clothing, avoid sun exposure) and monitor for excessive skin irritation, erythema, or photosensitivity reactions.
